headlines.title: Could the Suspected Pneumonic Plague Case in Russia Lead to an Outbreak? Experts Weigh in
headlines.description: The death of a lab technician in Russia from suspected pneumonic plague has sparked global alarm. Could it lead to a bigger outbreak, or a pandemic? Experts explain.

headlines.title: MAHA fractures deepen as some RFK Jr. followers turn into harsh critics
headlines.description: A scorecard from MAHA activists suggests the Trump administration has broken most of its promises to the movement. The “burn feels especially raw,” one prominent activist said.

headlines.title: I’ve Treated Breast Cancer for 25 Years. Here’s What I Learned From My Own Diagnosis
headlines.description: For more than 20 years, Dr. Jennifer Litton has been treating breast cancer. Getting diagnosed with breast cancer herself showed her how far treatment has come.

headlines.title: How Clean are Hotel Rooms? What to Know Before Checking in
headlines.description: A hotel room may appear to be squeaky clean but harmful germs could be lurking in places you might not expect. Plush carpets could inhabit E. coli and staph that can hitch a ride on shoes and wheeling suitcases. Reporting for TODAY, NBC’s Vicky Nguyen teams up with an environmental testing lab and books two room in New York City to swab for bacteria and viruses.

headlines.title: How to Set Boundaries at Home and at Work Without the Guilt
headlines.description: Setting boundaries can be difficult and guilt-inducing, but it doesn't have to be. Psychotherapist and author Niro Feliciano joins the 3rd Hour of TODAY to share helpful tips on how to set boundaries in your personal, romantic and work life. She explains how creating limits for yourself can foster healthier relationships and better mental health. "Anyone who has issues with your boundaries," Feliciano says, "they're the people who benefited from you not having them."

headlines.title: Foods to Add to Your Diet for a Healthy and Happy Gut
headlines.description: Maintaining a healthy gut is a vital way to lower risks of illnesses like heart disease and dementia. Gastrointestinal health expert Dr. Trisha Pasricha joins the 3rd Hour of TODAY to share tips to improve gut health, including eating more fiber, diversifying fruits and vegetables in meals, and introducing fermented foods into your diet.

headlines.title: WHO seeks answers and clarity over plague lab death in Russia
headlines.description: The World Health Organization is pushing for more answers and clarity in the plague death that happened in a lab in Russia. NBC News' Dr. Akshay Syal has more on what we know about the illness and what WHO is seeking from Russia.

headlines.title: Your humidifier could be pumping mold into the air — here is how to clean it
headlines.description: The benefits of a quality humidifier include moisturizing skin, fighting off allergens and even defending against dry lips and mouth, according to the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA).

headlines.description: Sunrise alarm clocks use light to wake you up gradually in the morning. Shop expert-recommended sunrise clocks from top brands like Hatch, Philips, Casper and more.

headlines.description: Walmart Deals includes discounts on your favorite appliances, tech, home goods and more — here are the best deals to shop now.

headlines.title: What to know about pneumonic plague after woman in Russia dies from mysterious illness
headlines.description: The death of a 28-year-old woman who worked in an anti-plague laboratory in Russia is raising concerns about what caused her illness.
